subject.title: gateway: malformed managed image data URLs can stall reply handling

question: Should maintainers land the open public gateway ReDoS fix PR, or route this denial-of-service report through private security handling first?
rationale: The code repair is narrow, but the affected input is model-supplied media on a stable gateway path and can stall reply handling, so automation should not choose the security handling boundary by itself.

options.title: Land after security-aware review
options.body: A gateway/security owner accepts the public handling route and reviews or lands the focused linear parser fix in the linked PR.

options.title: Route through security handling
options.body: Maintainers pause the public PR path and handle the denial-of-service issue through the repository security process before landing a fix.

options.title: Keep human-owned
options.body: A gateway owner keeps the issue open and patches manually if they want tighter control over the parser semantics or sibling regex scope.

recommendation.title: Land after security-aware review
recommendation.body: A gateway/security owner accepts the public handling route and reviews or lands the focused linear parser fix in the linked PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is ownership of the managed outgoing image feature and later managed-image hardening in the same module.
